tools.name: dealhub_get_quote
tools.description: Get one DealHub quote by its DealHub quote id, with the detail sections you ask for (info, summary, deal_room_info, line_items, answers, approvals, all). A draft with quote_upgrade_required=true returns no detail until someone saves it in the DealHub UI. DealHub: GET /api/v2/quote/{quote_id}.

tools.name: dealhub_list_quotes
tools.description: List DealHub quotes, optionally only those linked to one CRM opportunity. Returns 50 at most per page; more_results_matching_the_request says when to page on with offset. Avoid detail features on a full history sweep: they make large, slow responses. DealHub: GET /api/v2/quotes.

tools.name: dealhub_get_dealroom_signers
tools.description: Get who signed a contract in the DealRoom for a CRM opportunity: the DealRoom state, and the buyer and seller signers with names, titles and signature dates. DealHub: GET /api/v1/dealroom/{opportunity_id}.

tools.name: dealhub_list_versions
tools.description: List DealHub versions (the configuration that holds products, pricing and playbooks), optionally by status. The active version is the one quotes use. DealHub: GET /api/v1/versions.

tools.name: dealhub_get_version
tools.description: Get one DealHub version by its DealHub version id. DealHub: GET /api/v1/version/id/{version_id}.

tools.name: dealhub_list_users
tools.description: List DealHub users (sales reps, managers, admins), optionally only active or inactive ones. Passwords and tokens are never returned. DealHub: GET /api/v1/users.

tools.name: dealhub_get_user_by_login
tools.description: Get one DealHub user by login name (the unique, immutable login of the user). DealHub: GET /api/v1/user/login/{login}.

tools.name: dealhub_get_user_by_id
tools.description: Get one DealHub user by DealHub user id. DealHub: GET /api/v1/user/id/{id}.

tools.name: dealhub_create_opportunity
tools.description: Create a DealHub opportunity from a CRM opportunity, for example to start a renewal quote. Needs the CRM opportunity id, its owner (external_user_id, email, name), the currency and the customer. This writes a record in DealHub; the API error text says if the create fails. DealHub: POST /api/v1/oppor
